title: ESP32 legacy command profile (what firmware/src/main.cpp accepts)
description: Profile layer 2. Mirrors the firmware parser: commandId a string, capability and command strings, value a JSON boolean, timestamp an integer that fits a C long (32 bits on the ESP32). The closed allowlist (capability LED, command SET_STATE) is the profile's UNSUPPORTED rule in nexus_contract.rules and the freshness rule is absolute and 30 seconds (layer 4). A SERVO or RELAY command is valid under the generic contract and invalid under this profile.
x-nexus-rules: unsupported: capability must equal LED and command must equal SET_STATE, otherwise the firmware answers REJECTED/UNSUPPORTED
stale: abs(now - timestamp) > 30 seconds is REJECTED/STALE
